source.title: Improved constraint on the MINERvA medium energy neutrino flux using antineutrino-electron data
source.table_checked_against: APS published PDF Table IV, page 9 (012001-9); numerical table agrees with arXiv v1

last_bin_note: Published last bin is 9 GeV to infinity. Prediction is truncated at the supplied flux maximum; 100 GeV is a numerical edge, not a cut on the published data.
covariance_note: Absolute measurement covariance in events squared, including statistical and systematic measurement errors. It is not a predictive flux covariance. Use the upper-left 12x12 block when IMD is not included, retaining the FHC/RHC cross block. Do not add a second Poisson data-statistics term. Small beam-model effects in the published background/efficiency correction are part of the measurement covariance.

FHC.source: Valencia et al., arXiv:1906.00111v4, Sections II and VII

RHC.paper_POT_note: Zazueta manuscript and published article state 1.2e21 in Section II and 1.12e21 in the conclusion. Require an explicit POT argument; verify the exact exposure before a precision comparison.
RHC.target_note: Same 5.99-ton scintillator fiducial mass as FHC; electron count adopted from the FHC publication. Confirm exact RHC target normalization before final use.
